summary: One sidebar row: a link or a button, with an icon, a count, actions revealed on hover or focus, and nested items that expand.
useWhen: inside a SidebarSection, or nested inside another SidebarItem

useInstead.when: it is a link in a header bar
useInstead.why: NavItem recolours on hover without a fill, as measured for the header; sidebar rows fill

useInstead.when: it is a row in a dropdown

badge.note: a count or short status, trailing

actions.note: icon-only Buttons with aria-label, or a Menu trigger for more. Keep to two

children.note: nested items; their presence makes the row expandable

requires: `label` — the row's name, and the name of its expand button when it has children
guarantees: a row with `href` and children renders the link and a separate expand button beside it — a button cannot be nested in a link
a row with children and no `href` is a single button with aria-expanded
a row whose subtree holds the current page starts expanded
actions stay in the tab order and become visible when focus reaches them; they are always visible on touch screens

antiPatterns.dont: onClick on a row to navigate
antiPatterns.why: a real link opens in a new tab, shows its address and is announced as a link

antiPatterns.dont: actions nested inside the label or icon
antiPatterns.why: interactive content inside a link is invalid and unreachable by keyboard in most browsers

antiPatterns.dont: marking a parent isCurrent because a child page is open
antiPatterns.why: only the page the user is on is current; its ancestors are opened for them instead
